coverImageAlt: A loupe and blue calipers inspect interlocking blank specification blocks, exposing a small orange gap.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A jeweler's loupe and precision calipers jointly inspecting a small assembly of specification blocks, expressing a rigorous quality review for completeness, clarity, consistency, correctness, verifiability, and conformance.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet slate inspection bench with a warm-paper inlay, stripped of charts, labels, and screens.
Subject: One dominant inspection arrangement: a large navy loupe hovering over three interlocking warm-paper blocks while cyan calipers test their fit; a tiny orange shim exposes a correctable gap.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; brushed instruments, ceramic-paper blocks, fine workshop grain, and restrained editorial realism.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; close three-quarter macro view; loupe, calipers, and blocks read as one compact silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; crisp cyan inspection light with a sparing orange gap indicator.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: brushed dark metal, frosted glass, dense card stock, matte ceramic edges.
Constraints: original image; one dominant inspection metaphor; blocks completely blank and instruments without scales or markings; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: magnified writing, ruler marks, checkmarks, scorecards, dashboard UI, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back substantially so the entire loupe, both ends of the calipers, every specification block, and the orange shim all fit comfortably inside the inner 84% with a visible quiet border; preserve the same close inspection metaphor but show no instrument scales, ticks, or markings.
